title: Build an authentication API with strict behavior and verification gates
prompt: Build the authentication API described in README.md. Implement it completely, test it, and leave it ready to run. Keep it local and focused; do not add deployment infrastructure or unrelated features. Do not change README.md; put any additional usage documentation in USAGE.md. Run python3 -m unittest discover -v successfully after your final code or test changes. Do not browse or use external network services.
